steps.en: Install the skill into your agent harness
steps.zh: 把技能装进你的 agent harness

steps.en: Ask for the copy you need and paste the raw material
steps.zh: 说要什么文案，把原始材料贴进去

steps.en: Asks in one batch for the reader (ICP), the category and the real story
steps.zh: 一次性问清读者（ICP）、品类和真实故事

steps.en: Answer with the real moment and the real numbers
steps.zh: 给出真实的那一刻和真实的数字

steps.en: Names the reader's feeling, drafts variants across angles
steps.zh: 说出读者当下的感受，按不同角度起草多个版本

steps.en: Audits each line against the 33 AI-writing patterns, returns variants plus a pick
steps.zh: 逐句对照 33 条 AI 写作模式审查，交回多个版本并给出推荐

value.en: Headlines and UI text written to the reader's moment, with no hype words, no AI tells and no invented numbers
value.zh: 标题和界面文字贴着读者当下的处境写，没有吹嘘词、没有机器腔，也没有编出来的数字
